ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #3
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 21
   C. 42
   D. 30

2. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 23.7
   C. 23
   D. 29

3. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 34
   B. 22
   C. 66
   D. 17

4. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 2/2
   B. They are equal
   C. Cannot tell
   D. 1/4

5. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 21
   C. 15.7

   D. 37

8. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 31
   D. 2

9. What is √16? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 16
   C. 4
   D. 5

10. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 12x

11. What is √100? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 11
   C. 100
   D. 50

   D. 2

15. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 43

16. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 49

17. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 1/4
   C. 1/2
   D. Cannot tell

18. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)

   B. 45

   D. 33

   B. 44

   D. 22

21. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 40.5
   B. 81
   C. 9
   D. 10

22. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 38
   C. 60
   D. 19

23. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 27
   C. 25
   D. 17

24. Solve for x: x + 6 = 15. (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 6
   C. 10
   D. 15

25. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 400
   D. 40

26. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 36

   C. 37

27. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)

28. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)

   D. 156

29. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 4

30. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 65
   B. 64
   C. 0
   D. 16
